\section[kaiyeḻuttu]{\ta{கையெழுத்து} (kaiyeḻuttu) — a signature; handwriting}

\label{lesson:TA-C105-signature}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for an address, then the Tamil for a birthday.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{கையெழுத்து}}
\textbf{\ta{கையெழுத்து}} (\emph{kaiyeḻuttu}) — \textquotedblleft{}a signature\textquotedblright{}, and \textquotedblleft{}handwriting\textquotedblright{}, literally \textquotedblleft{}hand-writing\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\ta{கை}} is \textquotedblleft{}hand\textquotedblright{}; \textbf{\ta{எழுத்து}} is \textquotedblleft{}writing\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\ta{இங்கே} \ta{கையெழுத்துப்} \ta{போடுங்கள்}} — \textquotedblleft{}please sign here\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
A signature, built from hand and writing.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kaiyeḻuttu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kaiyeḻuttu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{iṅkē kaiyeḻuttup pōṭuṅkaḷ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for an address, then the Tamil for a birthday, then say \emph{kaiyeḻuttu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{கையெழுத்து} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A signature; handwriting\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[toḻil]{\ta{தொழில்} (toḻil) — an occupation, a trade}

\label{lesson:TA-C105-occupation}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for a birthday, then the Tamil for a signature.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{தொழில்}}
\textbf{\ta{தொழில்}} (\emph{toḻil}) — \textquotedblleft{}an occupation\textquotedblright{}, \textquotedblleft{}a trade\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\ta{உங்கள்} \ta{தொழில்} \ta{என்ன}?} — \textquotedblleft{}what is your occupation?\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The question after a name.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{toḻil}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{toḻil}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} ask \emph{uṅkaḷ toḻil eṉṉa?}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for a birthday, then the Tamil for a signature, then say \emph{toḻil} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{தொழில்} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An occupation, a trade\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[kallūri]{\ta{கல்லூரி} (kallūri) — a college}

\label{lesson:TA-C105-college}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for a signature, then the Tamil for an occupation.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{கல்லூரி}}
\textbf{\ta{கல்லூரி}} (\emph{kallūri}) — \textquotedblleft{}a college\textquotedblright{}.

It is built on \textbf{\ta{கல்}}, \textquotedblleft{}to learn\textquotedblright{}: a college is a \emph{learning-place}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Where a student studies.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kallūri}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kallūri}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{kallūri}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for a signature, then the Tamil for an occupation, then say \emph{kallūri} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{கல்லூரி} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A college\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[paḷḷi]{\ta{பள்ளி} (paḷḷi) — a school}

\label{lesson:TA-C105-school}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for an occupation, then the Tamil for a college.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{பள்ளி}}
\textbf{\ta{பள்ளி}} (\emph{paḷḷi}) — \textquotedblleft{}a school\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\ta{பள்ளிக்கூடம்}} is the fuller word; \textbf{\ta{பள்ளி}} alone is what people say.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Signature, occupation, college, school.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{paḷḷi}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for an occupation, then the Tamil for a college, then say \emph{paḷḷi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
